items.title: American Association of Endodontists Earns Four PRSA Chicago Skyline Awards of Excellence
items.summary: AAE recognized for integrated communications, misinformation response and innovative efforts to reach consumers with evidence-based information about saving natural teeth CHICAGO – Sept. 18, 2026 – The American Association of Endodontists (AAE) earned four honors at the 2026 Public Relations Society of America (PRSA) Chicago Skyline Awards, recognizing the Association’s work to combat health misinformation, educate…
